title: Arsonist's Oil
summary: Coat your active weapon set as a Bonus Action. Hits strip Fire resistance for 2 turns.

fields.Coating: Bonus Action. Consume one dose to coat the active weapon set for 10 turns, including both weapons when dual wielding. Use a separate dose for the other set. Replaces an existing coating and is mutually exclusive with dipping.
fields.Effect: A hit strips Fire resistance for 2 turns. It does not by itself grant Fire vulnerability. Wild Shape can apply the coating, but the pinned item page says it does nothing on those attacks.
fields.Base value: 25 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Throw: The shared coating table lists no applied effect from throwing this oil.
fields.Crafting: Combine Sublimate of Frosted Ears with any Ashes.

changes: Reconciled the item and linked gameplay rules with their pinned BG3 Wiki revisions, including item-specific qualifiers.
